risks: The patch specifies a useful fixture but supplies no revision-pinned host mapping, resolved stored Discovery records or executed round-trip evidence.

The negative-control rule treats native ok, storage and API reads as validation failures without distinguishing carrier acceptance from the required adapter rejection before executable review or admission.
The closure rule leaves unclear how validation-only stages and downstream stages intentionally unexecuted after required rejection can satisfy the closed disposition scheme.
Confidence values 0.82 and 0.4 contradict the statement that every number belongs to the safe-integer domain.
required_fixes: Execute and document at least the next bounded Discovery mapping probe with pinned host fields, resolved revisions and independent readback comparisons; keep subsequent unexecuted paths explicit.
Define rejection obligations per stage, permit appropriate evidence retention before the executable boundary, and specify downstream dispositions after required rejection.
Define the confidence-number domain separately from the integer domain and state the independent numeric comparison oracle.
scores.rationale: Mechanical validation passes, allowed files are respected, and Q0166 correctly remains Open without a schema-gap claim. The specimen and reporting vocabulary are useful preparation, but the actual mapping investigation remains unimplemented and the proposed reporting gate needs correction.

selection_rationale: The sole candidate passes mechanical validation. Its score credits useful preparation while reflecting missing mapping evidence and required reporting-rule fixes; committee aggregation remains the final selection mechanism.
